text:
leah-ps: Quick heads-up—ValenciaPay pilot next week. They expose one HTTP/2 tunnel and want to multiplex many logical streams. Main asks: Python mux snippet, small curl fallback, telemetry tags, ephemeral token rotation, and SOC2 questionnaire turnaround.

tom-sales: Demo Wed 10am CET. They start on Hosted, might request Dedicated if peaks are too spiky.

dev-runtime: Python mux minimal example:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='DEMO_KEY', enable_mux=True)
stream = c.stream(model='gpt-4o-infer', stream_id='vp-01')
for chunk in stream: print(chunk)
```
Fallback (curl):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

maria-devex: Telemetry tags we recommend per logical stream: service=valenciapay, stream_id, env=pilot, demo_id. For ephemeral tokens: rotate every 15m and include exp claim. I'll draft a 1-page runbook with a tiny validator script.

sec-bot: For SOC2: ask procurement to send the vendor questionnaire to security@redwood.ai. Need dataflow diagram + PII retention note. Turnaround usually 2-4 business days after receipt.

leah-ps: Can we have runbook + snippets by EOD Mon? I will share their questionnaire when proc responds.

dev-runtime: I can also attach a tiny load script to simulate 1k QPS on muxed streams before the demo.

tom-sales: Great, Ill bring a short cost note comparing Hosted burst credits vs a small Dedicated slice.

maria-devex: Scheduling quick sync Mon 9am PT to finalize materials.

leah-ps: Thanks team — will post initial payload shapes now.
